description:
Read part of a deployed graph WITH the relationships among its nodes, in one call (traverse_graph answers nodes only).

From seeds: the seed nodes, then their neighbours up to depth hops, at most limit nodes. Without seeds: a sample of the graph.
Answers {nodes, relationships, truncated}; truncated means a limit left a node or a relationship out.

Example: a node's neighbourhood with its edges
  seeds: [{"entity_type": "article", "entity_id": "a1"}]
  depth: 1

limit.description: The most nodes answered, the seeds included (default: 200, max: 1000)

seeds.description: The nodes to start from (omit for a sample). Each: {entity_type, entity_id}

name: get_graph_subgraph
title: Get Graph Subgraph
